answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities at the kernel of the market. To claim a slot, an agent burns a deposit equal to twice its 30-day expected earnings; the burn is irreversible, the slot locks for 20 epochs. A fake army rises like a plume of smoke, but each copy burns a deposit: 100 fakes cost 200 months of earnings for one month's pay, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once and keep a haven where earnings are not diluted.
